title: Security Incident Response
description: Security incidents affecting aerospace systems and sensitive data
triggers: Confirmed security incident affecting engineering or manufacturing systems
Unauthorized access to sensitive aerospace data
immediate_actions: Activate security incident response team immediately
Isolate affected systems to prevent further damage
investigation_steps: Identify scope and impact of security incident
Analyze attacker methods and access points
Assess data exposure and regulatory impact
resolution_steps: Contain security incident and prevent further access
Implement security patches and configuration changes
Restore systems from clean backups if needed
Coordinate with regulatory bodies if data breach confirmed
verification: Verify that security incident is contained
Confirm that attacker access is eliminated
Test security controls are functioning properly
Validate system integrity and data safety
special_considerations: Do not transfer restricted data to non-approved systems
Security incidents must follow the customer security incident response process
Aerospace data may have national security implications
Document all incident response activities for regulatory reporting
